identitySignals: OUSD Board agenda item 25-1802 names 'Native Soil Inc., Oakland, CA' for irrigation and landscaping at the Jefferson Child Development Center, matching the agenda text and the facilities/construction contracts
Native Soil Inc. is a landscape construction company in Oakland, CA (1721 Broadway, #201) with a California C27 landscape contractor license, matching OUSD's school-site improvement contracts
Its website lists Madison High School (an Oakland Unified school) as a completed project
A California corporation record for Native Soil Inc. at the same Oakland address (1721 Broadway Ste 201) shows landscape construction as its business
research.notes: The OUSD agenda item (ousd.granicusideas.com, meeting 2844, item 25-1802) supports the identity match but is not cited as a source. California entity number 4092009 comes from a third-party aggregator of Secretary of State data, so a reviewer may want to check it on bizfileonline.sos.ca.gov. The only email on the company site is a named individual's address (first initial + surname), so it was left out. The company is a for-profit corporation, so there is no EIN. SAM.gov UEI was not looked up.

profile.summary: Native Soil Inc. is a family-owned landscape architecture and construction company in Oakland, California, founded in 2015. It installs irrigation systems, plants, decomposed granite, and artificial and natural turf, and also offers landscape maintenance.
